gsc_snapshot.root_cause: auto-generated thin pages (product tags, low-value archive pages, and duplicated redirects) expanded the crawl graph and degraded domain quality signals. The auto-fix landing-page generator is now gated.

p0a_excluded_by_noindex.action: Audit complete. These are expected to be product_tag and archive pages that already carry noindex. Corrective action: KEEP noindex, ENSURE they are removed from sitemap, and preserve robots meta as noindex,follow. No money-page accidentally noindexed was found in sample. Money pages (home, services, commercial, products, area pages) are all indexable.
p0a_excluded_by_noindex.method: Yoast: disable product_tag/post_tag archive indexing; add canonical self on product_cat/post_cat; exclude from sitemap via Yoast search appearance settings.

p0b_crawled_not_indexed.action: Triaged. The largest bucket is product tags (539 in WP). They are thin because 1-3 products each. Corrective action: keep noindex, canonical self, and remove from internal links. For product categories with count<=1, noindex. For categories with >=2 products, keep indexed but add canonical self, unique h1/intro, and internal links.
p0b_crawled_not_indexed.method: Bulk update via WP SQL or Yoast bulk editor (requires WP admin or phpMyAdmin/SFTP).

p1a_404s.action: Identify dead URLs from GSC export and internal links. 301 to nearest live page; 410 only if permanently removed and no replacement. Remove dead links from navigation, sitemap, and content.
p1a_404s.method: Redirection plugin or .htaccess for 301s; grep content to remove dead internal links.

p1b_prune_taxonomy.action: 539 product_tag + 49 product_cat + 10 post_tag + 5 post_cat. Keep canonical strategy: product_tags noindexed and removed from sitemap; low-count categories noindexed; value categories indexed with unique content and canonical self.
p1b_prune_taxonomy.method: Yoast Search Appearance + functions.php filters + Yoast SEO sitemap exclusions.

p2a_sitemap_resubmit.action: Regenerate /sitemap_index.xml after pruning. Resubmit in GSC. Request validation for "Excluded by noindex" and "Crawled - currently not indexed" statuses.

p2b_url_inspection.action: URL-inspect money pages to confirm indexed + self-canonical. Money pages listed above already show noindex=False and correct canonical.

quality_gates_before_reenable.detail: Every new page must self-canonical; no tag/term should canonical to another page.
Block creation if proposed slug/title/content hash is within 85% similarity of existing page.
Hard cap on pages created per run (already present); additionally require owner approval if cap exceeds 5 in a week.
Only indexable money/area/category pages allowed in sitemap; all thin tags/archives excluded.
New pages must receive at least one internal link from a level-1 page within 48 hours.
Must have exactly one H1, unique title<=60 chars, unique meta<=155 chars before publish.
After re-enable, run weekly validation review for 4 weeks; roll back if not-indexed count rises by >10%.

rollback_notes.generator_gate: generator_enabled.json set to false; remove/flip file and restore auto_apply.py patch to re-enable.
rollback_notes.301_rollback: Store all rewrite rules in Redirection plugin (revisioned); htaccess changes backed up in recovery folder.
rollback_notes.meta_rollback: Before bulk meta changes, export current Yoast indexable table or save per-post json snapshots.
